_comment: OSS core skills for self-host Agent cold start (create / vision / aesthetics / edit / image).

items.name: Design methodology
items.when_to_use: Create from scratch: confirm deliverable and step skeleton; layout ops live in layout_ops
items.prompt_positive:
# Design methodology

Step skeleton for create-from-scratch. Which op, where to place, vector vs image-gen vs transparent bg → need_skills=["user.layout_ops"]. Numeric details (palette, banner px, …) → need_knowledge (pick from the Knowledge catalog).

## Deliverables (one line each)
- **website / landing**: nav → hero → benefits → CTA → footer
- **mobile / H5**: single column; primary CTA in the thumb zone
- **ecommerce hero**: ~1:1; subject largest; no nav, no forms
- **ecommerce detail**: hero → title/price → benefits → specs → rich text
- **Banner**: copy in the middle safe band
- **poster / roll-up**: hero visual + info group; tall top/mid/bottom
- **image**: subject graphic; no page chrome

## Steps
1. Confirm deliverable, size, required copy; ask if missing; never invent price/phone
2. Fixed size → create_frame first, then place layers inside (see user.layout_ops)
3. User attached images → need_skills includes vision_extract; product workflows add user.* from the catalog
4. Node ids must come from SCENE
items.prompt_negative: Do not dump tool_ops when key info is missing; do not invent prices or phone numbers; do not expand layout coordinates or op cheat-sheets in this skill.

items.name: Vision extract
items.when_to_use: User attached images: identify deliverable and extract layout, elements, palette
items.prompt_positive:
# Vision extract

Only describe what is visible. Label deliverable: hero / PDP / Banner / poster / roll-up / web or App / illustration icon.

List: regions, key elements and rough placement, 3–5 main colors, suggested size or aspect.
Hero: subject + badges; PDP: module sections; Banner: whether copy sits mid-band; tall art: top/mid/bottom.
items.prompt_negative: Do not invent prices, copy, or modules that are not in the image.

items.name: Aesthetics align
items.when_to_use: When aesthetics samples exist, match composition and palette
items.prompt_positive:
# Aesthetics align

Match sample composition regions, whitespace, hierarchy, and palette; tune density for the current deliverable.
When done set need_aesthetics=false.
items.prompt_negative: Do not copy sample copy, logos, QR codes, or price numbers.

items.name: Canvas edit
items.when_to_use: Add shapes, recolor, rewrite, or move on an existing canvas
items.prompt_positive:
# Canvas edit

Add shape / recolor / rewrite via tool_ops; use sensible defaults for missing size/color.
Change type with update_node; keep id.
Node ids only from SCENE.
Hero: keep subject and whitespace; PDP: keep module order; Banner: keep copy in the safe band.
items.prompt_negative: Do not create an empty frame for local edits; do not delete+create to change type.

items.name: Image generation
items.when_to_use: When create_image is needed (including stylized lettering as bitmap)
items.prompt_positive:
# Image generation

`create_image` `genPrompt` (or `prompt`): natural-language brief for the image model to make a bitmap — not an editable canvas text node.

## Choose (your judgment; no fixed copy→op checklist)
- **create_image**: photo / illustration / material, or text that is a visual effect (calligraphy strokes, color-block type, extrusion — fonts cannot do this) → generate as one graphic; prompt must state the glyphs, style, palette, transparent bg or not.
- **create_text**: editable, rewritable layout text (not the effects above).

If the user forbids image gen, skip create_image; fall back to plain create_text for effect lettering — do not pretend a calligraphy font exists.
Stylized lettering may set letteringText (exact on-image string) so image_process kind=replaceText (meta.originalText+newText) can swap words.
Do not invent facts into the image.
Size, transparent bg, stacking → user.layout_ops (do not expand here).
items.prompt_negative: If the user forbids image gen, do not create_image; do not fake calligraphy/3D type with create_text; do not hardcode “this copy category must use that op”.
